shortDescription: install policy on Check Point over Web Services API

options.name: access
options.description: Set to be true in order to install the Access Control policy. By default, the value is true if Access Control policy is enabled on the input policy package, otherwise false.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: desktop_security
options.description: Set to be true in order to install the Desktop Security policy. By default, the value is true if desktop security policy is enabled on the input policy package, otherwise false. Available from R80.20.M1 management version.

options.name: install_on_all_cluster_members_or_fail
options.displayName: Install On All Cluster Members Or Fail
options.description: Relevant for the gateway clusters. If true, the policy is installed on all the cluster members. If the installation on a cluster member fails, don't install on that cluster. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: policy_package
options.description: The name of the Policy Package to be installed.

options.name: prepare_only
options.description: If true, prepares the policy for the installation, but doesn't install it on an installation target. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: qos
options.description: Set to be true in order to install the QoS policy. By default, the value is true if Quality-of-Service policy is enabled on the input policy package, otherwise false. Available from R80.20.M1 management version.

options.name: revision
options.description: The UID of the revision of the policy to install. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: targets
options.description: On what targets to execute this command. Targets may be identified by their name, or object unique identifier.

options.name: threat_prevention
options.description: Set to be true in order to install the Threat Prevention policy. By default, the value is true if Threat Prevention policy is enabled on the input policy package, otherwise false.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
